name: manifest-build
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import pathlib,json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
L=pathlib.Path.cwd();excluded=['hash-manifest.json','manifest-build.receipt.json','manifest-build.output.txt','final-verify.receipt.json','final-verify.output.txt']
hashes={str(p.relative_to(L)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(L.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and str(p.relative_to(L)) not in excluded}
s=json.dumps({'algorithm':'SHA256','files':hashes,'exclusions':excluded,'reason':'Manifest cannot include its own hash or future/current runner-generated output/receipts. Those late receipts remain independently inspectable; no all-files self-coverage claim.'},indent=2)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),'hash-manifest.json'],input=s,text=True,check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
assert all(hashlib.sha256((L/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in hashes.items())
print('VERIFIED_ACTUAL_HASHES',len(hashes),'MANIFEST',hashlib.sha256((L/'hash-manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
